headline: Wardens Take Two Works at Linn Mercy; Nevish Line Falls Quiet
war_summary: The Nevish Line, aflame in the last edition, has gone quiet at the map table: the count still stands at five Warden works, two Colonial and one unclaimed, but no action has been logged there in more than two hours, though the day's total reaches thirty-eight and casualties still run near 400 Colonial and 540 Warden in the past hour. The sharper change came at Linn Mercy, where Warden forces have taken two works from no-man's-land; the ledger now reads eight Colonial, two Warden and one unclaimed, with twenty-three actions in the day and losses climbing fast — roughly 570 Colonial and 1,050 Warden in the past hour alone. In the Weathered Expanse one further work has passed to Colonial hands, leaving three apiece and three unclaimed, on fifty-three actions over the day. Marban Hollow holds at four Warden works to three Colonial, one unclaimed, and remains briskly contested. Callahan's Passage stays the bloodiest posting, near 83 Colonial and 69 Warden casualties in the last hour, its ten Warden works unchanged. The wider map remains overwhelmingly Colonial, with Warden strength massed in the north and west.
